scientific_integrity: The elementary all-modulus argument uses the standard quadratic Gauss-sum sign. Finite checks corroborate but cannot replace the proof. Historical priority is not certified, especially for an older rank-deficiency paper whose full text was unavailable.
scientific_limitations: Only odd moduli and positive-sign Fourier matrices restricted to invertible row and column residue indices are covered; no arbitrary-minor classification or even-modulus statement. The nonzero condition number is not the condition number of a singular operator.
title: Complete eigenphase spectrum of primitive-index Fourier minors over odd moduli
